title: A composition of birational morphisms is birational
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a composition of birational morphisms is birational. After an immediate reduction to irreducible schemes, the proof works with the unique minimal primes of the coordinate rings: the assumptions say that the minimal prime of the middle ring lies over that of the source and defines the function field extension as an isomorphism, and the same holds for the second map, so the composition has the same property, which is exactly birationality.
